entries.title: One Light-Day · Voyager 1
entries.feeling: Voyager 1 is one light-day from us. Inspired by Emanuele Coccia, Métamorphoses. Now, as a whole, we existed 1 day ahead of ourselves in the future. The future is the simple truth that we are wandering, drifting beings. The capsule bearing our history has now become a cocoon, carrying all the future of mankind within itself. From it, new life will emerge, one that does not belong to any of us, either as individuals or as a species. And in that moment, we shall finally become the sky again: by nature, by matter, and by form.

entries.title: White Nights · Dostoevsky
entries.feeling: A story about longing and heartbreak — not romance. Haven’t finished a book in a long time. The essence of longing is the tragedy of fleeing reality. Finished 22:18.
